goal: Allow kernel library callers and tests to set clock time per instance rather than through global state
Eliminate intermittent test flakes caused by race conditions across second boundaries
agreement: Unaddressed objection: PR may be obsolete after #35496 and conflicts with approach in #35906 (maflcko)
Prefers setter on chainstate over options, but questions whether it is worth the effort (sedited)
Ergonomics concern about managing clocks per object was answered with an alternative prototype (stickies-v)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it lets concurrent kernel instances set mock time independently without shared global state
Enforces kernel boundaries by catching accidental nondeterministic clock usage at link time

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because scoped time checks prevent second-boundary race conditions in isolated validation tests
The impact is limited to testing safety rather than fixing production consensus issues
